title: pilea racemosa
intro: Pilea racemosa, commonly known as the Chinese Evergreen, is a species of flowering plant in the family Urticaceae. It is native to tropical regions and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Pilea racemosa include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which may contribute to its health benefits. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which may be responsible for its therapeutic actions.
